verdict.rationale: Docs confirm core lifecycle automation building blocks: automations triggered by events/segments, branching via Wait Until with chained delays, exit rules implied via automation components, plus broadcasts/transactional messages for other lifecycle stages (docs-12, docs-18, docs-30, docs-35). Community evidence (comm-1) corroborates real-world usage building workflows, though comm-6 notes some limitation-driven churn. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit-rule configuration and independent hands-on validation of complex branching/winback flows.
